section13_checks.prohibition_description: Grant Agreement Annex used as governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Invented call constraints, scope requirements, outcomes or impacts not in Tier 2B.
Invented project facts (partners, roles, capabilities) not in Tier 3.
Phase 8 activity commenced before the budget gate passed.
Durable decisions stored only in agent memory, not written to Tier 4.
Skill or workflow expanding scope to become a de facto constitutional authority.
Silent phase reordering or weakening of gate conditions.
Finalised text produced from incomplete source state without flagging the gap.
Generic programme knowledge substituted for Tier 1 source documents.
Tier 5 outputs not traceable to Tier 1-4 inputs.
Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents modified to reflect project assumptions.
CLAUDE.md treated as advisory or optional.

check_notes.13.1: Structural authority for sections is section_schema_registry.json (Tier 2A, RIA application form; sections A.4, B.3, B.3.1, B.3.2). References to 'Grant Agreement or Consortium Agreement obligations' and 'grant_agreement_implementation_articles' appear only as governance/escalation basis, not as a proposal schema. No Annex template used as structural authority.
